subject: Net 30?
body:
Hi there,

We're a brand new shop (opening this summer) and would like to place a custom order, about 12,000 8oz cups with a 1 color logo. We'd need Net 30 terms though. Is that possible?

Brooke Tanner
Sugar Pine Sweets
needs_human_reason: Payment-terms (Net 30) request (rule 3). The account has no order history, so it doesn't meet the 6-month requirement; only the owner can decide.
summary: Brand-new shop (opening this summer) wants 12k 8 oz 1-color cups ($1,625) on Net 30. Doesn't qualify (no history); standard 50% deposit terms explained; owner decides.
draft_reply:
Hi Brooke,

Congrats on the new shop! Net 30 is only available for accounts with at least 6 months of order history plus owner approval, so I can't offer it on a first order, but I've passed your request to our owner, who will follow up. Our standard terms are a 50% deposit to start production, with the balance due before shipping (we take credit card and ACH).

Here's your quote for 12,000 8 oz cups with a 1-color logo:

12,000 x $0.115 = $1,380.00
Setup: 1 color x $150 = $150.00
Freight: $95.00 flat (orders under $2,500)
Total: $1,625.00

These are printed by our USA partner (Pantone matching available) and ship 3-4 weeks after you approve the digital proof, so there's plenty of time before summer. Whenever you're ready, send your logo as a vector file (AI, EPS, PDF, or SVG). This quote is an estimate, good for 30 days, and doesn't include sales tax.

The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: Ships within the lower 48 (location not stated).
owner_note: No order history, so not eligible for Net 30 under policy. Draft explains the standard deposit terms; your call if you want to make an exception.
